arxiv-1901-05429.title: HEP Software Foundation Community White Paper Working Group – Conditions Data
arxiv-1901-05429.creator: Marko Bracko, Marco Clemencic, Dave Dykstra, Andrea Formica, Giacomo Govi, Michel Jouvin, David Lange, Paul Laycock, and Lynn Wood
arxiv-1901-05429.description: Abstract To produce the best physics results, high energy physics experiments require access to calibration and other non-event data during event data processing. These conditions data are typically stored in databases that provide versioning functionality, allowing physicists to make improvements while simultaneously guaranteeing the reproducibility of their results.

arxiv-2106-13190.title: Vibrational effects in the quantum dynamics of the H + D + 2 {}_{2}^{+} charge transfer reaction
arxiv-2106-13190.creator: O. Roncero a , V. Andrianarijaona b,c , A. Aguado d and C. Sanz-Sanz d
arxiv-2106-13190.description: Abstract The H + D + 2 {}_{2}^{+} (v=0,1 and 2) charge transfer reaction is studied using an accurate wave packet method, using recently proposed coupled diabatic potential energy surfaces. The state-to-state cross section is obtained for three different channels: non-reactive charge transfer, reactive charge transfer, and exchange reaction.

arxiv-2203-12120.title: Matrix Completion with Heterogeneous Cost
arxiv-2203-12120.creator: Ilqar Ramazanli
arxiv-2203-12120.description: Abstract The matrix completion problem has been studied broadly under many underlying conditions. In many real-life scenarios, we could expect elements from distinct columns or distinct positions to have a different cost. In this paper, we explore this generalization under adaptive conditions. We approach the problem under two different cost models.

arxiv-2212-01085.title: Contact Topology and the Classification of Disclination Lines in Cholesteric Liquid Crystals
arxiv-2212-01085.creator: Joseph Pollard, Gareth P. Alexander
arxiv-2212-01085.description: Abstract We give a topological classification of defect lines in cholesteric liquid crystals using methods from contact topology. By focusing on the role played by the chirality of the material, we demonstrate a fundamental distinction between ‘tight’ and ‘overtwisted’ disclination lines not detected by standard homotopy theory arguments.

arxiv-2302-13053.title: Scalable Neural Network Training over Distributed Graphs
arxiv-2302-13053.creator: Aashish Kolluri, * Sarthak Choudhary, * Bryan Hooi, and Prateek Saxena School of Computing, National University of Singapore aashish7@comp.nus.edu.sg, csarthak76@gmail.com, {bhooi, prateeks}@comp.nus.edu.sg
arxiv-2302-13053.description: Abstract . Graph neural networks (GNNs) fuel diverse machine learning tasks involving graph-structured data, ranging from predicting protein structures to serving personalized recommendations. Real-world graph data must often be stored distributed across many machines not just because of capacity constraints, but because of compliance with data residency or privacy laws.

arxiv-2401-13592.title: RI − - Calc: A User Friendly Software and Web Server for Refractive Index Calculation Journal: Computer Physics Communications
arxiv-2401-13592.creator: Leandro Benatto †, Omar Mesquita, Lucimara S. Roman, Marlus Koehler, Rodrigo B. Capaz, Graziâni Candiotto †
arxiv-2401-13592.description: Abstract The refractive index of an optical medium is essential for studying a variety of physical phenomena. One useful method for determining the refractive index of scalar materials ( i.e , materials which are characterized by a scalar dielectric function) is to employ the Kramers − - Kronig (K − - K) relations.

arxiv-2411-00199.title: Denoising study of Fluoroscopic Images in real time tumor tracking System based on Statistical model of noise
arxiv-2411-00199.creator: Yongxuan Yan, Fumitake Fujii, Takehiro Shiinoki
arxiv-2411-00199.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yongxuan Yan, Fumitake Fujii, Takehiro Shiinoki. This study investigates the noise characteristics of intraoperative X-ray fluoroscopic images acquired during real-time image-guided radiotherapy (IGRT), and presents a novel noise image generation method based on the identified noise amplitude and spatial probability patterns. Initially, noise-free digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) were generated using patient CT data combined with projection algorithms and the spatial configuration of the real-time tumor tracking system.

arxiv-2504-06709.title: Universal profile for cosmic birefringence tomography with radio galaxies
arxiv-2504-06709.creator: Fumihiro Naokawa
arxiv-2504-06709.description: Abstract We propose a new method to tomographically probe cosmic birefringence using radio galaxies. We show that the redshift evolution of the cosmic birefringence angle induced by a slow-rolling pseudoscalar field, which is a candidate for dynamical dark energy, is independent of the detailed model of the pseudoscalor field.

openalex-w7221020698.description: Este estudo teve como objetivo sintetizar as evidências sobre os efeitos da aplicação integrada do ciclo Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) e da Manutenção Produtiva Total (TPM) no desempenho operacional de processos industriais e analisar sua aplicabilidade à indústria farmacêutica....

pmc-10478811.title: The 2023 Impact of Inflammatory Bowel Disease in Canada: Special Populations—Children and Adolescents with IBD
pmc-10478811.creator: Wael El-Matary, Matthew W Carroll, Colette Deslandres, Anne M Griffiths, M Ellen Kuenzig, David R Mack, Eytan Wine, Jake Weinstein, Rose Geist, Tal Davis, Justin Chan, Rabia Khan, Priscilla Matthews, Gilaad G Kaplan, Joseph W Windsor, Charles N Bernstein, Alain Bitton, Stephanie Coward, Jennifer L J
pmc-10478811.description: Rates of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in Canadian children and adolescents are among the highest in the world, and the incidence is rising most rapidly in children under five years of age. These young children may have either a typical form of IBD with multi-factorial aetiology, or they may have a monogenic form.

pmc-12366626.title: Depression among medical students in Bangladesh: a systematic review and meta-analysis protocol on prevalence and associated factors
pmc-12366626.creator: Mantaka Rahman, Sharmin Sultana, Ummul Khair Alam, Imtiaz Abdullah, Afroza Tamanna Shimu, Nusrat Fatema
pmc-12366626.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionDepression, affecting 350 million people globally, is notably prevalent among medical students, particularly in South Asia, including Bangladesh. Despite several studies, no meta-analysis has systematically examined the prevalence and contributing factors of depression to address the mental health burden.

pmc-12452453.title: Accuracy of the Mini-Mental State Examination and Montreal Cognitive Assessment in Detecting Cognitive Impairment in Older Adults: A Comparative Study Adjusted for Educational Level
pmc-12452453.creator: Paula Andreatta Maduro, Leandro Paim da Cruz Carvalho, Luiz Alcides Ramires Maduro, Ana Beatriz da Costa Rodrigues, Alaine Souza Lima Rocha, Lilian Ramine Ramos de Souza Matos, Marcelo de Maio Nascimento, Bruno Bavaresco Gambassi, Paulo Adriano Schwingel
pmc-12452453.description: Early detection of cognitive decline in older adults is essential for implementing timely interventions. This study aimed to compare the diagnostic accuracy of the Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE®) and the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA©) in identifying cognitive impairment among community-dwelling older adults, while considering the effect of educational level.

pmc-12508088.title: Molecular mediators of cold adaptation in mammalian cells
pmc-12508088.creator: Paulami Dey, Heera Lal, Pushpita Saha, Arvind Ramanathan
pmc-12508088.description: Hypothermia is defined as a drop in temperature below the homeostatic range of cells and tissues. This elicits a response in mammalian cells geared towards cellular and metabolic adaptation. Hibernating mammals provide natural models of cold tolerance and adaptation. Mammalian cells across species share signaling mechanisms for adaptation to hypothermic stimuli.

pmc-12581245.title: Global burden of disease analysis of stroke due to high systolic blood pressure in different regions, 1990–2021
pmc-12581245.creator: Yu-xin Liu, Man-man Zhang, Xin-yi Huang, Yu Zheng, Xian-xian Yu, Xue Li, Min Zhang, Yu-yuan Zhang, Fu-yong Hu
pmc-12581245.description: Background and purposeStroke is a major global cause of death, disability, and socioeconomic burden. This study analyzed long-term trends in burden of stroke attributable to high systolic blood pressure (HSBP), to evaluate the effect of HSBP control in stroke prevention.MethodsThe Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 database was utilized.

pmc-12608867.title: Evaluating a 30-Hour Training Program for Community Health Workers on 4Ms Implementation in FQHCs Using the Kirkpatrick Model
pmc-12608867.creator: Sweta Tewary, Cherell Cottrell-Daniels, Kevin Espinoza, Katherine Chung-Bridges, Diego I Shmuels, Deborah Gracia, Joycelyn J Lawrence, Victor R Prybutok
pmc-12608867.description: Objective: To evaluate a 30 h educational program delivered to community health care workers (CHWs) involved in geriatric care within a primary care clinic, measure increase in knowledge, likelihood of using the education, and baseline results of geriatric screenings for patients 65 and older conducted by CHWs in their clinics.

pmc-12688597.title: Pemetrexed plus platinum outperforms other platinum-based adjuvant chemotherapy regimens for resected stage II–IIIA lung adenocarcinoma: an open-label, historical-control study
pmc-12688597.creator: Xumeng Ji, Qiwen Zheng, Bo Jia, Lingdong Kong, Yuling He, Xiaoyu Zhai, Tongtong An, Jianjie Li, Yuyan Wang, Yujia Chi, Jingjing Wang, Lu Ding, Yidi Tai, Reyizha Nuersulitan, Xingsheng Hu, Fan Yang, Ziping Wang
pmc-12688597.description: BackgroundEarly-stage lung adenocarcinoma has the potential to achieve long-term survival through radical surgery and appropriate adjuvant therapy. Despite rapid advancements in perioperative treatment strategies, postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy remains critically valuable. However, the optimal adjuvant chemotherapy regimen is yet to be established.

pmc-13026639.title: Sarcopenia and Comorbidity Burden Independently Predict Cough Impairment in Hospitalized Patients: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13026639.creator: Marco Casciaro, Sara Manti, Delia Mammano, Antonella Gambadauro, Giorgio Basile, Chiara Tombetti, Silvano Cincotti, Francesco Nucera, Sebastiano Gangemi, Paolo Ruggeri
pmc-13026639.description: Background and Objectives: Peak Cough Flow (PCF) is an objective measure of cough effectiveness, traditionally used in patients with neuromuscular disorders. Sarcopenia may also impair respiratory muscles, but its relationship with cough efficacy in hospitalized patients with respiratory diseases is not well established.

pmc-13122742.title: Human medical documentation significantly outperforms ChatGPT‐4o in critical clinical dimensions: A blinded comparative assessment in paediatric orthopaedics
pmc-13122742.creator: Carlo Camathias, Kata Papp, Patrick Betschart, Berhard Speth, Victor Valderrabano, Elias Ammann
pmc-13122742.description: PurposeThis study evaluated the quality of ChatGPT‐generated medical history summaries compared to human‐created documentation in a paediatric orthopaedic practice setting.MethodsA prospective, randomised, blinded comparative study was conducted involving 20 consecutive paediatric patients (mean age 14.2 ± 2.3 years; 11 males, 9 females) presenting with knee problems.

pmc-13396750.title: Ultra-processed and High fat-salt-sugar (HFSS) foods in India: a dual-axis framework for regulation
pmc-13396750.creator: Sneha Chakraborty, SubbaRao M Gavaravarapu, Samarasimha Reddy N, Bharati Kulkarni
pmc-13396750.description: in high- and middle-income countries.2 India remains under-represented due to limited data on UPF consumption, health outcomes and market size. pmc-13608978.title: Beyond Pain Intensity: Central Sensitization and Psychosocial Symptom Burden in Women with Rheumatoid Arthritis
pmc-13608978.creator: Maja Vučković, Dragana Kožul, Tamara Popović, Ivan Soldatović, Sandra Trivunović, Tatjana Nožica Radulović, Daria Ćupurdija, Snežana Tomašević Todorović
pmc-13608978.description: Background and Objectives: Persistent pain in rheumatoid arthritis (RA) may reflect mechanisms not fully captured by systemic inflammatory markers. This study estimated the frequency of elevated Central Sensitization Inventory (CSI) scores in women with RA and examined associations with pain, fatigue, depressive symptoms, function, inflammatory markers, and disease activity.

pmc-13661863.title: What health are we talking about? Biodiversity as the missing link between One Health and Planetary Health
pmc-13661863.creator: Jonas Geschke, Simone Sommer, Michael Schloter
pmc-13661863.description: Health has become a central term in global sustainability policy, yet it is often used without sufficient conceptual precision. Public health, global health, One Health, EcoHealth, GeoHealth, and Planetary Health each emphasize different dimensions of the relationship between humans, animals, and the environment. In policy contexts, however, these distinctions are frequently blurred.
